name: Muang Thai Chiang Mai Marathon
short_description: Muang Thai Chiang Mai Marathon takes place December 20, 2026 in Chiang Mai, Thailand.
ai_summary: Muang Thai Chiang Mai Marathon is a road running event in Chiang Mai, Thailand, featuring Full Marathon; Half Marathon; 10km. The race takes place on December 20, 2026, starting from Tha Phae Gate (start); King Naresuan the Great Monument, Mae Rim (finish). Registration is Open as of the last check. This listing is compiled from official race sources and aggregators and is refreshed regularly.
